title: Chorthippus biguttulus - sound
author: Baudewijn Odé
changes: Bow-winged grasshopper (Chorthippus biguttulus) stridulating: one rising song phrase, made by rubbing its hind legs against its wings. Trimmed to 20.60–23.10 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.7 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. From the Odé collection 'Sounds of grasshoppers and crickets of Northwestern Europe'. No high-pass: the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
